description: Synthetic transcripts for the demo sample cleaner. sample is the locked output of DemoSampleCleanup. reference is a hand-labeled fuller cleanup, not a measured model output.

cases.note: A standalone hesitation is removed and the sentence is capitalized.

cases.raw: Um, hmm, send it at 5, uh, not 6.
cases.note: Hesitations go away. The number and the real negation stay.
An immediate repeated word is collapsed.
Deliberate emphasis is kept. The output checks treat very/really/extremely as emphasis.
The sample cleaner does not try to decide when like is a filler.
Numbers stay. The sample cleaner does not insert the comma the reference has.
The sample cleaner does not resolve spoken self-corrections. The production prompt does.
Both quantities stay in the sample. The reference keeps only the correction.
An internal capital is left alone so the word still matches the protected-token check.
A one-word utterance is capitalized and punctuated.
Existing paragraph breaks stay. Only the first word is capitalized.
Text that already looks like JSON is not rewritten.
